Select IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human sodium-dependent dopamine transporter (CHEMBL238). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_records on activities.record_id to retrieve compound_key and docs for pubmed_id_or_doi. Join compound_structures as INNER JOIN to require canonical_smiles. Filter by target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL238' and activities.standard_type = 'IC50'. Return all requested columns including activity_comment and target details. Do not use DISTINCT; preserve row multiplicity. Sort by all requested output columns.
